import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_45/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_45/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Inspect schemas:
# df0 columns: ['State', 'Participation', 'English', 'Math', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']
# df1 columns: ['State', 'Participation', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math', 'Total']

# Transformation plan:
# - Target columns:
#   ['State': string,
#    'Participation_x': string,  # from df0.Participation
#    'English': float,           # from df0.English
#    'Math_x': float,            # from df0.Math
#    'Reading': float,           # from df0.Reading
#    'Science': float,           # from df0.Science
#    'Composite': float,         # from df0.Composite
#    'Participation_y': string,  # from df1.Participation
#    'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer,  # from df1.'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing'
#    'Math_y': integer,          # from df1.Math
#    'Total': integer]           # from df1.Total
#
# - Join df0 and df1 on 'State' (inner join to keep only states present in both)
# - Rename columns from df0.Participation -> Participation_x, df0.Math -> Math_x
# - Rename columns from df1.Participation -> Participation_y, df1.Math -> Math_y
# - Ensure correct dtypes: 
#   Participation_x and Participation_y as string (percentage strings)
#   English, Math_x, Reading, Science, Composite as float
#   Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, Math_y, Total as integer

# Rename columns before merge to avoid collision
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_x",
    "Math": "Math_x"
})

df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_y",
    "Math": "Math_y"
})

# Merge on 'State'
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on="State", how="inner")

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema
target_columns = [
    'State',
    'Participation_x',
    'English',
    'Math_x',
    'Reading',
    'Science',
    'Composite',
    'Participation_y',
    'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing',
    'Math_y',
    'Total'
]

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Convert dtypes:
# Participation_x and Participation_y are already strings (percentage strings like "62%")
# English, Math_x, Reading, Science, Composite to float
float_cols = ['English', 'Math_x', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']
df_target[float_cols] = df_target[float_cols].astype(float)

# Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, Math_y, Total to integer
int_cols = ['Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math_y', 'Total']
df_target[int_cols] = df_target[int_cols].astype(int)

# Save to target CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_45/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
